status.summary: NTT DATA's OSK11 facility page, in its version modified on 20 October 2026, says that the Keihanna OSK11 data centre, which opened in February 2026, supplies a total IT load of 30 MW to 10,900 m2 of server rooms in a four-storey base-isolated building in Seika, Kyoto, and describes in the present tense the services it provides, its 24-hour on-site security and its Tier III-equivalent infrastructure. This records OSK11 as operating on 20 October 2026, the modification day of the captured version (NTT DATA sitemap lastmod 2026-10-20T03:37:50+09:00, bounded by the Internet Archive copy of 9 April 2026, which shows the same OSK11 text with older markup, and the live capture of 27 October 2026); it is not an opening date. February 2026 is the operator-stated opening month and 9 April 2026 the formal opening announcement. A stale blurb on NTT DATA's data-centre top page still says the facility is to open (開設予定); it is contradicted by the facility page and the opening announcement and is not used. The 30 MW and 3,800 racks are design figures, not load in service.
